operation.body:
### Goal

Implement **FR-005**: local feedback and category changes survive a real process restart using the same SQLite database file.

### Acceptance criteria

- Demonstrate that created feedback items and category changes remain available after a **new Rails process** loads the same on-disk test database (not merely an in-process reload or query-cache clear).
- Add automated integration coverage at an appropriate boundary: seed data via the app stack, then verify counts/attributes in a separate child process (for example `bin/rails runner` with `RAILS_ENV=test` against the same database path).
- Cover at least one created item and one recategorized item in the restart evidence test.
- Run `bin/rails test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement broader invalid-request handling (FR-006), sample dataset or final docs pass (FR-008), or edits to `docs/security-review.md`.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Branch name must include `issue-<n>`. Keep the change reviewable in one PR.

### Out of scope

Missing-record handling beyond existing flows, authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, and unrelated documentation churn.

### Relevant context

FR-001–FR-004 are on `main` (goals #12, #14, #16, #18; PRs #13, #15, #17, #19): SQLite-backed `Feedback` model with submit, browse, categorize, and filter flows. See `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-005 and acceptance details for process-boundary persistence evidence.
